decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic yogurt line closely tied to the firm's core organic dairy capabilities and strategic direction, and with no visible sign that results have fallen below aspiration levels, management would be likely to continue it.

This mild sliced cheese is a low-distance extension of the firm's established cheese business, so in a growing market and with some organisational slack the firm would usually keep it while it learns whether performance reaches aspirations.

The sliced butter cheese also fits existing production and customer channels, and absent clear evidence of underperformance a boundedly rational management would more likely retain it for another year than reallocate resources immediately.
